svg.text: PLACEHOLDER: replace me with your drawing
ola/modules/tdr/ - Time domain (TDR): where a fault is along a cable
When it is seen: time-domain measurement of a line (cable) with the VNA.
What to draw: the VNA with P1 connected, with a test lead, to the near end of a long cable
(draw it wavy or coiled, clearly different from the test lead). At the other end three
possibilities, drawn as three alternative endings (or one end with three symbols side by side):
open (free connector), short (short cap), device (a box, for example an antenna).
Details: on the cable a fault point (a crush, a connector) with an arrow and the letter d, and
a dimension line that goes from the calibration plane (the end of the test lead, dashed with
CAL) to that point: the distance is measured from there.
Save your drawing with this name (.svg, .png, .jpg or .webp). While this file is here, the program uses its own diagram.
